title: Inspection inputs sizing resolution disparity in Pullback sub-mode
description: In frontend/app/(frame)/screener/step-4-prebreakout/page.tsx:218-220, inspectionInputs passes raw inspectionRisk.portfolioValue and inspectionRisk.maxLossPerTradePct to SavedScanReportInspector. In contrast, the actual scan dispatch (line 158) resolves sizing through scanSizingFromRisk(), which validates positivity, handles 0% fallbacks, and clamps sizing parameters. If risk limits contain unvalidated values, the inspection input payload does not exactly reflect the executed scan parameters.
remediation: Update inspectionInputs in Pullback mode to call scanSizingFromRisk() when building account_size and risk_pct.

title: Asynchronous run_id capture latency in Pre-Breakout / Fib scan metadata
description: In frontend/app/(frame)/screener/step-4-prebreakout/page.tsx:186, 202, runId is captured via a metadata callback passed into api.fibPullbackScan and api.prebreakoutScan. If network response headers or report generation fails, runId remains null, displaying 'Displayed rows: run identity unavailable for the rows shown' even when rows were successfully parsed.
remediation: Return run_id directly in the envelope response or persist run identity synchronously with candidate rows.

title: Setup-origin candidate chart backtest hydration is unsupported for Pre-Breakout and Fib setups
description: Opening a Pre-Breakout or Fib Pullback row via ↗ (buildCandidateChartHref) sets status to 'unsupported', rendering 'Original backtest unavailable: unsupported. Live chart below; no historical result has been substituted.' Pullback mode supplies full BacktestArtifact references. The candidate chart currently supports backtest curves only for Pullback setups.
remediation: Natively tracked under issue #391 (SETUP-BACKTEST-CHART), which adds breakout_setup and fibonacci_pullback backtest artifacts to Candidate Chart.
